baker_routine.text: Every day. Morning to night. Routine is good. Keeps the hands busy.

baker_core_path.text: I hear that if I’m not useful… I’m nothing.

responses.text: You don’t stop being someone when you rest.

baker_ending.text: …Gracias. I think I knew that. I just never said it out loud.
